## Packages

```{r packages, error=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(monocle)
library(igraph)
library(Matrix)
library(DESeq2, include.only = character())
library(DDRTree, include.only = character())
library(VGAM, include.only = character())
library(Biobase, include.only = character())
library(edgeR, include.only = character())
```

## Samples and conditions

```{r samples-and-conditions, error=FALSE}
sample_cols <- c("WD1", "WD2", "WD3", "Ext1", "Ext2", "Ext3", "Ret-Ext1", "Ret-Ext2", "Ret-Ext3")
metadata <- data.frame(
  pool_id = sample_cols,
  source_sample_id = c("Con1", "Con2", "Con3", "Ext1", "Ext2", "Ext3", "Ret_ext1", "Ret_ext2", "Ret_ext3"),
  model = rep("Rat IL", 9L),
  condition = factor(rep(c("WD", "Ext", "Ret-Ext"), each = 3L), levels = c("WD", "Ext", "Ret-Ext")),
  rats_per_pool = rep(5L, 9L), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions, error=FALSE}
# Input checks and native DESeq2 calculations for the expression workflows.
require_packages <- function(packages) {
  absent <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(absent)) stop("Install the required R packages: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
}

limit_threads <- function() {
  Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
             MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1", OMP_THREAD_LIMIT = "1")
  if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L)
  }
}

new_output_dir <- function(path) {
  if (dir.exists(path) && length(list.files(path, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE))) {
    stop("Choose an empty output directory: ", path)
  }
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  normalizePath(path, mustWork = TRUE)
}

read_table <- function(path) {
  read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
           fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
}

write_table <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.csv(x, path, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
}

write_session <- function(out) {
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(out, "session_info.txt"))
}

pool_ids <- sample_cols
pool_conditions <- setNames(as.character(metadata$condition), sample_cols)

read_ieg_payload <- function(path, neuronal_class) {
  require_packages("Matrix")
  q <- readRDS(path)
  stopifnot(all(c("counts", "metadata", "gene_annotation") %in% names(q)))
  x <- q$counts
  md <- q$metadata
  ann <- q$gene_annotation
  stopifnot(inherits(x, "sparseMatrix"),
            all(c("Cell", "pool_id", "condition", "IEGhigh") %in% names(md)),
            all(c("seurat_feature", "gene_id", "original_symbol") %in% names(ann)),
            identical(colnames(x), as.character(md$Cell)),
            identical(rownames(x), as.character(ann$seurat_feature)),
            !anyDuplicated(md$Cell), !anyDuplicated(rownames(x)),
            all(md$IEGhigh), setequal(md$pool_id, pool_ids),
            identical(as.character(md$condition), unname(pool_conditions[as.character(md$pool_id)])),
            all(is.finite(x@x)), all(x@x >= 0), all(x@x == round(x@x)))
  if ("neuron_type" %in% names(md)) stopifnot(all(md$neuron_type == neuronal_class))
  q
}

aggregate_pools <- function(q) {
  group <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = seq_len(ncol(q$counts)),
                               j = match(q$metadata$pool_id, pool_ids),
                               x = 1, dims = c(ncol(q$counts), length(pool_ids)))
  counts <- as.matrix(q$counts %*% group)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(counts)), all(counts >= 0), all(counts <= .Machine$integer.max))
  dimnames(counts) <- list(rownames(q$counts), pool_ids)
  storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"
  counts
}

make_pool_metadata <- function(pools, levels) {
  data.frame(pool_id = pools, condition = factor(unname(pool_conditions[pools]), levels),
             row.names = pools)
}

expression_filter <- function(counts, metadata) {
  unname(edgeR::filterByExpr(edgeR::DGEList(counts, group = metadata$condition),
                            design = model.matrix(~ condition, metadata)))
}

fit_native_deseq <- function(counts, metadata, eligible, numerator, denominator,
                             allow_convergence_retry = FALSE,
                             contrast = c("condition", numerator, denominator)) {
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts), rownames(metadata)), any(eligible),
            length(eligible) == nrow(counts), !anyNA(eligible))
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts[eligible, , drop = FALSE],
                                       metadata, design = ~ condition)
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric", sfType = "ratio",
                       betaPrior = FALSE, minReplicatesForReplace = 7L,
                       quiet = TRUE, parallel = FALSE)
  initial <- S4Vectors::mcols(dds)$betaConv
  retried <- any(is.na(initial) | !initial)
  if (retried && allow_convergence_retry) {
    dds <- DESeq2::nbinomWaldTest(dds, betaPrior = FALSE, maxit = 1000, quiet = TRUE)
  }
  stopifnot(all(S4Vectors::mcols(dds)$betaConv),
            all(DESeq2::counts(dds) == counts[eligible, , drop = FALSE]),
            !("replaceCounts" %in% SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(dds)))
  res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast = contrast,
                         alpha = 0.05, independentFiltering = TRUE,
                         pAdjustMethod = "BH", parallel = FALSE)
  threshold <- as.numeric(S4Vectors::metadata(res)$filterThreshold)
  family <- is.finite(res$pvalue) & res$baseMean >= threshold
  stopifnot(length(threshold) == 1L, is.finite(threshold),
            identical(unname(is.finite(res$padj)), unname(family)))
  if (any(family)) {
    stopifnot(all(abs(res$padj[family] - p.adjust(res$pvalue[family], "BH")) < 1e-12))
  }
  list(model = dds, result = res, filter_threshold = threshold,
       convergence_retry = retried && allow_convergence_retry)
}

native_de_table <- function(fit, counts, annotation, eligible, neuronal_class,
                            numerator, denominator) {
  r <- as.data.frame(fit$result)
  idx <- match(rownames(counts), rownames(r))
  mc <- S4Vectors::mcols(fit$model)
  cooks <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(fit$model)[["cooks"]]
  max_cooks <- apply(cooks, 1, function(x) if (any(is.finite(x))) max(x[is.finite(x)]) else NA_real_)
  z <- data.frame(
    gene = rownames(counts), gene_id = annotation$gene_id,
    original_symbol = annotation$original_symbol, eligible = eligible,
    tested = eligible & is.finite(r$pvalue[idx]),
    in_BH_family = eligible & is.finite(r$padj[idx]),
    baseMean = r$baseMean[idx], log2FoldChange = r$log2FoldChange[idx],
    lfcSE = r$lfcSE[idx], stat = r$stat[idx], pvalue = r$pvalue[idx],
    padj = r$padj[idx], maxCooks = max_cooks[idx], betaConv = mc$betaConv[idx],
    neuron_type = neuronal_class, numerator = numerator, denominator = denominator,
    method = "DESeq2", n_pools = ncol(counts), n_per_condition = 3L,
    independentFiltering = TRUE, alpha = 0.05, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  z$status <- ifelse(!eligible, "filtered_low_expression_before_fit",
                     ifelse(!z$tested, "native_P_withheld",
                            ifelse(!z$in_BH_family, "independent_filter_low_mean", "tested_with_native_BH")))
  z$BH_significant <- z$in_BH_family & z$padj < 0.05
  z$display_DEG <- z$BH_significant & abs(z$log2FoldChange) >= log2(1.15)
  z$DE_direction <- ifelse(z$display_DEG, ifelse(z$log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                           ifelse(z$in_BH_family, "Not significant", "Not in BH family"))
  z
}
```

## Monocle 2 compatibility

```{r monocle-2-compatibility, error=FALSE}
# Compatibility with igraph 2.2.1 and scalar matrix checks in Monocle 2.
# These replacements are process-local and do not alter installed package files.
edit_call <- function(x, old, new) {
  if (is.call(x)) {
    if (is.symbol(x[[1]]) && identical(as.character(x[[1]]), old)) x[[1]] <- as.name(new)
    for (i in seq_along(x)) x[i] <- list(edit_call(x[[i]], old, new))
  }
  x
}

edit_argument <- function(x, old, new) {
  if (is.call(x)) {
    if (!is.null(names(x))) names(x)[names(x) == old] <- new
    for (i in seq_along(x)) x[i] <- list(edit_argument(x[[i]], old, new))
  }
  x
}

edit_projection_check <- function(x) {
  if (is.call(x)) {
    if (identical(x, quote(class(projection) != "matrix"))) return(quote(!is.matrix(projection)))
    for (i in seq_along(x)) x[i] <- list(edit_projection_check(x[[i]]))
  }
  x
}

apply_monocle2_compatibility <- function() {
  toy <- quote({ projection <- NULL; zz <- a[, 1]; z <- nei("a"); dfs(g, neimode = "all")
                 if (class(projection) != "matrix") projection <- as.matrix(projection) })
  expected <- quote({ projection <- NULL; zz <- a[, 1]; z <- .nei("a"); dfs(g, mode = "all")
                      if (!is.matrix(projection)) projection <- as.matrix(projection) })
  stopifnot(identical(edit_projection_check(edit_call(edit_argument(toy, "neimode", "mode"),
                                                       "nei", ".nei")), expected))
  ns <- asNamespace("monocle")
  update <- function(name, edit) {
    fn <- get(name, envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)
    body(fn) <- edit(body(fn))
    locked <- bindingIsLocked(name, ns)
    if (locked) unlockBinding(name, ns)
    on.exit(if (locked) lockBinding(name, ns), add = TRUE)
    assign(name, fn, envir = ns)
  }
  update("extract_ddrtree_ordering", function(x) edit_argument(x, "neimode", "mode"))
  update("project2MST", function(x) edit_projection_check(edit_call(x, "nei", ".nei")))
}
```

## Analysis and output

```{r analysis-and-output, error=FALSE}
# Nine-pool DESeq2 ranking and the twenty prespecified Monocle 2 signature fits.
limit_threads()
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_COLLATE", "C"))
require_packages(c("DESeq2", "Matrix", "monocle", "DDRTree", "igraph", "VGAM", "Biobase", "dplyr"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(monocle)
  library(igraph)
  library(Matrix)
})
versions <- c(DESeq2 = "1.50.2", monocle = "2.38.0", DDRTree = "0.1.5",
              igraph = "2.2.1", dplyr = "1.1.4")
observed <- vapply(names(versions), function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), character(1))
if (!identical(versions, observed)) {
  stop("Use the recorded package versions for trajectory reproduction: ",
       paste(names(versions), versions, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
}
out <- new_output_dir(result_dir)
q <- read_ieg_payload(exc_payload, "Excitatory")
pb <- aggregate_pools(q)
baseline <- read_table(deg_table)
stopifnot(identical(baseline$gene, rownames(pb)), all(baseline$neuron_type == "Excitatory"),
          all(baseline$n_pools == 6L), all(baseline$numerator == "Ret-Ext"),
          all(baseline$denominator == "Ext"), all(baseline$independentFiltering),
          all(baseline$alpha == 0.05))
keep <- as.logical(baseline$eligible)
md <- make_pool_metadata(pool_ids, c("Ext", "Ret-Ext", "WD"))
fit <- fit_native_deseq(pb, md, keep, "Ret-Ext", "Ext", contrast = c(0, 1, 0))
stopifnot(identical(DESeq2::resultsNames(fit$model),
                    c("Intercept", "condition_Ret.Ext_vs_Ext", "condition_WD_vs_Ext")))
de <- native_de_table(fit, pb, q$gene_annotation, keep, "Excitatory", "Ret-Ext", "Ext")
write_table(de, file.path(out, "nine_pool_DESeq2_ALL_genes.csv"))
write_table(data.frame(gene = rownames(pb), eligible_in_six_pool_fit = keep),
            file.path(out, "six_pool_filter_used_for_nine_pool_fit.csv"))
write_table(data.frame(md, total_counts = colSums(pb)), file.path(out, "nine_pool_metadata.csv"))

sizes <- c(10L, 20L, 30L, 40L, 50L, 100L, 200L, 300L, 400L, 500L)
valid <- de$tested & is.finite(de$log2FoldChange) & de$log2FoldChange != 0
directions <- list(F = valid & de$log2FoldChange > 0, G = valid & de$log2FoldChange < 0)
selected <- list()
for (panel in names(directions)) {
  d <- de[directions[[panel]], , drop = FALSE]
  d <- d[order(d$pvalue, -abs(d$log2FoldChange), d$gene), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(nrow(d) >= max(sizes))
  d$rank_in_direction <- seq_len(nrow(d))
  for (size in sizes) {
    id <- sprintf("%s_Top%03d", panel, size)
    z <- head(d, size)
    z$case_id <- id
    z$panel <- panel
    z$N <- size
    selected[[id]] <- z
  }
}
write_table(do.call(rbind, selected), file.path(out, "all20_selected_genes.csv"))
```

## Normalize the trajectory inputs

```{r normalize-the-trajectory-inputs, error=FALSE}
# Signature-independent count preprocessing, computed once on all eligible nuclei.
nuclear_md <- q$metadata
nuclear_md$condition <- factor(nuclear_md$condition, levels = c("WD", "Ext", "Ret-Ext"))
rownames(nuclear_md) <- nuclear_md$Cell
features <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(q$counts), row.names = rownames(q$counts))
set.seed(42)
base <- newCellDataSet(q$counts,
                       phenoData = methods::new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = nuclear_md),
                       featureData = methods::new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = features),
                       expressionFamily = VGAM::negbinomial.size())
base <- estimateSizeFactors(base)
base <- estimateDispersions(base, cores = 1)
apply_monocle2_compatibility()

edge_table <- function(graph) {
  x <- igraph::as_data_frame(graph, what = "edges")
  ends <- cbind(pmin(x$from, x$to), pmax(x$from, x$to))
  x$from <- ends[, 1]
  x$to <- ends[, 2]
  x <- x[order(x$from, x$to), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(x) <- NULL
  x
}
```

## Fit each signature-guided trajectory

```{r fit-each-signature-guided-trajectory, error=FALSE}
fit_case <- function(s) {
  id <- s$case_id[1]
  panel <- s$panel[1]
  n <- s$N[1]
  dest <- file.path(out, "cases", id)
  result <- data.frame(case_id = id, panel = panel, N = n, status = "failed",
                       failure_stage = NA_character_, failure_reason = NA_character_,
                       mean_Ext = NA_real_, SEM_Ext = NA_real_,
                       mean_RetExt = NA_real_, SEM_RetExt = NA_real_,
                       delta_RetExt_minus_Ext = NA_real_, Welch_t = NA_real_,
                       Welch_df = NA_real_, Welch_P = NA_real_,
                       CI95_difference_low = NA_real_, CI95_difference_high = NA_real_,
                       secondary_exact20_pool_permutation_P = NA_real_,
                       selected_State = NA_integer_, WD_nuclei_selected_State = NA_integer_,
                       principal_root = NA_character_, projected_root = NA_character_)
  stage <- "DDRTree fit"
  tryCatch({
    cds <- setOrderingFilter(base, s$gene)
    set.seed(42)
    cds <- reduceDimension(cds, max_components = 2, reduction_method = "DDRTree")
    stage <- "Initial ordering"
    cds <- orderCells(cds)
    pre <- pData(cds)
    principal <- minSpanningTree(cds)
    graph <- cds@auxOrderingData[["DDRTree"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_tree
    closest <- cds@auxOrderingData[["DDRTree"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
    stopifnot(identical(rownames(pre), colnames(cds)),
              identical(rownames(closest), colnames(cds)),
              identical(V(graph)$name, colnames(cds)), ecount(graph) == ncol(cds) - 1L)
    leaves <- names(which(degree(graph) == 1L))
    states <- sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(pre$State))))
    stopifnot(length(states) > 0L, !anyNA(pre$State), !anyNA(states))
    stage <- "Root selection"
    choices <- lapply(states, function(state) {
      root <- tryCatch(getFromNamespace("select_root_cell", "monocle")(cds, root_state = state, reverse = FALSE),
                       error = function(e) NA_character_)
      index <- which(V(principal)$name %in% root)
      valid_root <- length(root) == 1L && !is.na(root) && length(index) == 1L
      mapped <- if (valid_root) V(graph)$name[which(as.vector(closest) == index)] else character()
      terminal <- mapped[mapped %in% leaves]
      data.frame(State = state, WD_nuclei = sum(as.character(pre$State) == state & pre$condition == "WD"),
                 principal_root = if (valid_root) root else NA_character_,
                 projected_root = if (length(terminal)) terminal[1] else NA_character_,
                 eligible = valid_root && length(terminal) > 0L)
    })
    choices <- do.call(rbind, choices)
    choices$selected <- FALSE
    feasible <- which(choices$eligible)
    if (length(feasible)) {
      ix <- feasible[order(-choices$WD_nuclei[feasible], choices$State[feasible])][1]
      choices$selected[ix] <- TRUE
    }
    write_table(choices, file.path(dest, "root_state_eligibility.csv"))
    if (!length(feasible)) stop("No structurally feasible root state; no fallback root is used.")
    chosen <- choices[choices$selected, , drop = FALSE]
    reduced_s <- reducedDimS(cds)
    reduced_k <- reducedDimK(cds)
    stage <- "Ordering at selected root"
    set.seed(42)
    cds <- orderCells(cds, root_state = chosen$State)
    pd <- pData(cds)
    final_graph <- cds@auxOrderingData[["DDRTree"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_tree
    root_cell <- cds@auxOrderingData[["DDRTree"]]$root_cell
    stopifnot(identical(root_cell, chosen$projected_root),
              identical(reducedDimS(cds), reduced_s), identical(reducedDimK(cds), reduced_k),
              identical(edge_table(minSpanningTree(cds)), edge_table(principal)),
              identical(edge_table(final_graph), edge_table(graph)),
              identical(pd$State, pre$State), all(is.finite(pd$Pseudotime)))
    root_distance <- as.numeric(distances(final_graph, v = root_cell, to = colnames(cds),
                                           weights = edge_attr(final_graph, "weight")))
    stopifnot(max(abs(root_distance - pd$Pseudotime)) < 1e-8)
    cells <- data.frame(Cell = colnames(cds), pool_id = pd$pool_id, condition = pd$condition,
                        State = pd$State, Pseudotime = pd$Pseudotime,
                        DDRTree_1 = reduced_s[1, ], DDRTree_2 = reduced_s[2, ])
    write_table(cells, file.path(dest, "nuclear_pseudotime.csv"))
    stage <- "Pooled-sample comparison"
    means <- aggregate(Pseudotime ~ pool_id + condition, cells, mean)
    names(means)[names(means) == "Pseudotime"] <- "sample_mean_pseudotime"
    means$n_nuclei <- as.integer(table(cells$pool_id)[as.character(means$pool_id)])
    means$case_id <- id
    means$panel <- panel
    means$N <- n
    x <- means$sample_mean_pseudotime[means$condition == "Ext"]
    y <- means$sample_mean_pseudotime[means$condition == "Ret-Ext"]
    stopifnot(length(x) == 3L, length(y) == 3L)
    tt <- t.test(y, x, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")
    pooled <- c(x, y)
    permuted <- apply(combn(6L, 3L), 2L, function(ix) mean(pooled[ix]) - mean(pooled[-ix]))
    result$status <- "success"
    result$mean_Ext <- mean(x); result$SEM_Ext <- sd(x) / sqrt(3)
    result$mean_RetExt <- mean(y); result$SEM_RetExt <- sd(y) / sqrt(3)
    result$delta_RetExt_minus_Ext <- mean(y) - mean(x)
    result$Welch_t <- unname(tt$statistic); result$Welch_df <- unname(tt$parameter)
    result$Welch_P <- tt$p.value
    result$CI95_difference_low <- tt$conf.int[1]; result$CI95_difference_high <- tt$conf.int[2]
    result$secondary_exact20_pool_permutation_P <-
      mean(abs(permuted) >= abs(result$delta_RetExt_minus_Ext) - 1e-12)
    result$selected_State <- chosen$State
    result$WD_nuclei_selected_State <- chosen$WD_nuclei
    result$principal_root <- chosen$principal_root
    result$projected_root <- root_cell
    write_table(means, file.path(dest, "all9pool_mean_pseudotime.csv"))
    list(test = result, means = means)
  }, error = function(e) {
    result$failure_stage <- stage
    result$failure_reason <- conditionMessage(e)
    message(id, " failed at ", stage, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    list(test = result, means = NULL)
  })
}
```

## Run the signature grid and save results

```{r run-the-signature-grid-and-save-results, error=FALSE}
fits <- lapply(selected, fit_case)
tests <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, `[[`, "test"))
tests$size_N <- tests$N
tests$BH20 <- p.adjust(tests$Welch_P, method = "BH", n = 20L)
tests <- tests[order(tests$N, tests$panel), , drop = FALSE]
write_table(tests, file.path(out, "tables", "all20_tests.csv"))
means <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, `[[`, "means"))
if (!is.null(means)) {
  means$size_N <- means$N
  write_table(means, file.path(out, "source_data", "all20_pool_means.csv"))
}
write_session(out)
```
